remarks:
Here is your chance to own a little slice of heaven in beautiful Cattaraugus County! 9+ acres of mostly level land offer a choice of building sites. Well maintained trails throughout the property give access to every corner. Currently used as a weekend getaway camp, this property was once a tree plantation; there is a wide variety of species including, Maple, Cherry, Spruce, Poplar, Pine, Larch and even Dawn Redwood!
These offer ideal habitat for a variety of wildlife including deer, turkey, songbirds, small mammals and even the occasional bear! A small stream runs across the front corner of the property. Electric service has been installed and there is a working well with a submersible pump and pressure tank, as well as a newer metal sided and roofed shed (approx 16 by 20) and an older wooden shed.  All this on a quiet country road offering peace and privacy, you're just a couple miles down the road from Zoar Valley Multi-use Area for kayaking, rafting, hiking, and fishing and 15 minutes from Springville for shopping and restaurants.
